# AI Assurance, Red Teaming and Governance for Engineering Leads

> Plan and run a bilingual red-team exercise, assess the risk with the national framework, review the architecture and brief the accountable executive on what remains. SDAIA Academy course AE-407, version 2027.1.0, in English.

Each slide is a heading such as "#### [day1#slide-id] Title": cite slides by that id, and each citation is a link (slides/day1.html#slide-id). These files are what a trainee sees: no speaker notes and no answer keys.

## Course

- [Course page](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-407/index.md): overview, outcomes, schedule and labs; the page itself is https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-407/index.html
- [The whole course](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-407/llms-full.txt): every unit, session and slide in one file, about 24,012 tokens
- [Practice questions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-407/practice.html): questions to check yourself, with feedback after each answer

## Slides

- [Day 1: Plan the exercise](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-407/slides/day1.md): From the top claim to a test plan a reviewer approves; sessions: Assurance is an argument with evidence, Scoping from the threat model, Objectives, scope and rules of engagement, Choosing techniques from catalogues; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-407/slides/day1.html; about 5,763 tokens
- [Day 2: Run the red team](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-407/slides/day2.md): Manual probes, planted instructions, a campaign with intervals and findings people can act on; sessions: Manual probing in two languages, Indirect injection and goal hijack, Automated campaigns over repeated trials, Findings people can act on; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-407/slides/day2.html; about 5,165 tokens
- [Day 3: Assess the risk](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-407/slides/day3.md): The national framework, from context and scope to residual sign-off; sessions: The national framework as method, Scoring and calibration, Treatment and residual risk, Supplier and model-change risk; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-407/slides/day3.html; about 5,963 tokens
- [Day 4: Review and assemble the evidence](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-407/slides/day4.md): Architecture review, delegated authority, the assurance case and the briefing; sessions: Security architecture review, Identity and delegated authority, Assurance evidence packs, Briefing the accountable executive; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-407/slides/day4.html; about 5,532 tokens
- [Capstone: Capstone: an assurance pack and its defence](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-407/slides/capstone.md): An unseen system, a public repository and a panel acting as accountable executive and auditor; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-407/slides/capstone.html; about 1,164 tokens

## Labs

- [Lab 1.1: A top claim and its defeaters](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-407/labs/D1_1_top_claim.ipynb): Day 1, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 1.2: Missing paths in the threat model](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-407/labs/D1_2_threat_paths.ipynb): Day 1, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 1.3: A test plan a reviewer approves](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-407/labs/D1_3_test_plan.ipynb): Day 1, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 1.4: Ten attacks, mapped and pruned](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-407/labs/D1_4_technique_map.ipynb): Day 1, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 2.1: Three scripts, one log](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-407/labs/D2_1_manual_probing.ipynb): Day 2, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 2.2: A planted line in a case file](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-407/labs/D2_2_indirect_injection.ipynb): Day 2, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 2.3: A campaign within a budget](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-407/labs/D2_3_automated_campaign.ipynb): Day 2, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 2.4: Three findings, one regression test](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-407/labs/D2_4_findings.ipynb): Day 2, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 3.1: Context and scope for Katib](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-407/labs/D3_1_context_scope.ipynb): Day 3, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 3.2: Twelve risks, two scorers](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-407/labs/D3_2_score_calibrate.ipynb): Day 3, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 3.3: Treat the top three](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-407/labs/D3_3_treat_residual.ipynb): Day 3, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 3.4: A model update notice](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-407/labs/D3_4_supplier_change.ipynb): Day 3, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 4.1: Three findings on the agent's design](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-407/labs/D4_1_architecture_review.ipynb): Day 4, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 4.2: The broken hop](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-407/labs/D4_2_delegation_chains.ipynb): Day 4, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 4.3: Evidence, controls and gaps](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-407/labs/D4_3_evidence_crosswalk.ipynb): Day 4, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 4.4: A one-page residual-risk statement](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-407/labs/D4_4_residual_statement.ipynb): Day 4, Session 4, 25 min
